description_en: Deletes one or more compute nodes from a specified cluster
description_zh: 调用DeleteNodes删除指定集群中一个或多个计算节点
name: DeleteNodes

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html查询集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to release the nodes created by E-HPC.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh:
是否释放由E-HPC创建的节点。

默认值：true
parameters.name: release_instance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the nodes directly. Valid values:

true: Yes.

false: No
parameters.help_zh:
是否直接删除节点。取值范围：

true：是

false：否
parameters.name: sync

fields.help_en:
The ID of the compute node to be deleted. Valid values of N: 1 to 100.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87126.html operation to query the IDs of the nodes in a specified cluster
fields.help_zh:
要删除的计算节点ID。N的取值范围：1~100

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87126.html查询指定集群中的节点ID
fields.name: id

parameters.help_en: The information about the nodes to be deleted
parameters.name: instance

TaskId.description_en:
The task ID.

If Sync is set to true, this operation is synchronous and TaskId is Not Available.

If Sync is set to false, this operation is asynchronous. You can call the [ListTasks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268225.html） operation to query the task execution result
TaskId.description_zh:
任务ID。

您可以调用[ListTasks]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/268225.html）查询任务运行结果
